name: blind_hole_says_how_deep_it_is
why: ENTRY GT12, points 1, 2 and 3. A 120 x 80 x 10 plate with a through Ø12 and a blind Ø8 5 deep. Measured with the little test rig on 26/9/2026: the callout of SOLIDWORKS puts the depth in the suffix by itself («<HOLE-DEPTH>5») and «THRU» (THRU in an English installation) for the through hole; from the side view the holes are not dimensioned (their contours are not edges). And the text of every dimension has a rectangle that can be read (IDisplayData): none must fall on another text or on a line of the part.
defect_caught: The blind hole dimensioned without a depth (in the workshop it gets drilled through), a hole dimensioned also from the side view, and a dimension text on top of another text or on top of the drawing.
_the_views_are_called_by_uid: V1 front (the thickness), V2 from above (the holes as circles), V3 side.

expect.tolerance_why: pi inside: 96000 minus pi x 6^2 x 10
pi inside: minus pi x 4^2 x 5. The blind one second: afterwards, its bottom is another «up» face and the selector would become ambiguous

expect.why: a view attaches to the FILE of the part
the holes in order of diameter: the Ø8 first
the depth of the blind hole, re-read from the callout: without it, in the workshop it gets drilled through
the blind one does not say THRU
the depth read from the cylinder and its bottom: it is the one the bridge writes when the callout is not born
the other circle of the Ø12 is an inner ring of the bottom face: the hole comes out
the rectangles of the texts, read by SOLIDWORKS: none on another text or on a line of the part
from the side view the holes are not dimensioned: diameters and positions are already on the view from above
also with the dimensions of two views
